message: Ticket #101: We cannot fulfill Tauhid Zaman’s request for one CC-TEE-WHITE tee in size S from current stock; Inventory reports 0 on hand (short by 1). Recommended next step: inquire about restock availability/timing and then offer the requester a restock option or an alternative.
recommended_action: Human follow-up needed to obtain restock availability/timing or decide on an alternative for the requester.

message: Ticket #103 concerns a price override, so Accounting reviewed the hoodie pricing. The recorded unit cost is $22 and list price is $58; for 20 units, that is $1,160 at list price against $440 in product cost. The pricing data provides no discount policy or required margin threshold, so a specific bulk discount cannot be confirmed as authorized. Recommend no discount until a human approves a defined override. Inventory availability was not assessed.
recommended_action: Human review and approval are required before applying any discount; specify the approved unit price or discount amount.
